description: Source code for the GPIO driver for MCP23xxx I2C/SPI-based GPIO expanders in Zephyr RTOS, including register access, pin configuration, interrupt handling, and initialization.

methods.name: read_port_regs
methods.description: Reads register(s) from MCP23xxx device, handling port size based on number of GPIOs.

methods.name: write_port_regs
methods.description: Writes register(s) to MCP23xxx device, handling port size based on number of GPIOs.

methods.name: write_iocon
methods.description: Writes to the IOCON register, ensuring value is mirrored for 16-pin devices.

methods.name: setup_pin_dir
methods.description: Configures the direction (input/output) of a specific GPIO pin.

methods.name: setup_pin_pull
methods.description: Configures pull-up or pull-down resistors for a GPIO pin.

methods.name: mcp23xxx_pin_cfg
methods.description: Configures a GPIO pin's direction and pull-up/down settings.

methods.name: mcp23xxx_port_get_raw
methods.description: Reads raw port value from MCP23xxx device.

methods.name: mcp23xxx_port_set_masked_raw
methods.description: Sets port bits with a mask.

methods.name: mcp23xxx_port_set_bits_raw
methods.description: Sets specific bits on the port.

methods.name: mcp23xxx_port_clear_bits_raw
methods.description: Clears specific bits on the port.

methods.name: mcp23xxx_port_toggle_bits
methods.description: Toggles specific bits on the port.

methods.name: mcp23xxx_pin_interrupt_configure
methods.description: Configures interrupt mode and trigger for a GPIO pin.

methods.name: mcp23xxx_manage_callback
methods.description: Manages GPIO callbacks for interrupt handling.

methods.name: mcp23xxx_work_handler
methods.description: Interrupt handler work function for processing GPIO interrupts.

methods.name: mcp23xxx_int_gpio_handler
methods.description: GPIO callback for interrupt pin, submits work for processing.

methods.name: gpio_mcp23xxx_init
methods.description: Initializes the MCP23xxx GPIO driver, configures reset and interrupt lines, and sets up device.
